title: 第二十章 大壮，你太厉害了！
content_zh:
林婉仪咬着嘴唇，脚踝处的疼痛感越来越强烈，像是有无数根针在扎。

    她今天下午还有重要的客人要招待，身为运营总监，她必须在场，绝对不能缺席。

    “你真的能治？”她看着王大壮，眼神里带着一丝怀疑，“你不是只会种水果吗？怎么还会治筋骨？”

    “学过一点，祖传的手艺。”王大壮咧嘴一笑，也不多解释，“林姐，你忍着点，可能会有点酸胀感，但不会疼。”

    说着，他双手握住林婉仪的左脚，掌心贴在她肿胀的脚踝上，体内灵气缓缓催动，渡入她的脚踝之中。

    灵气渗入筋脉的瞬间，林婉仪感觉到一股温热的气流从脚踝处蔓延开来，那种刺痛感迅速消退，取而代之的是一种酸酸胀胀的舒适感，像是泡在温水里一样。

    王大壮的眼睛一眨不眨地盯着她的脚踝，灵目术让他清楚地看到，灵气流过之处，那些扭曲错位的筋脉像是被一只无形的手轻轻捋顺，一点一点地恢复到原本的位置。

    肿胀的软组织在灵气的滋养下迅速修复，瘀血消散，红肿消退。

    这个过程持续了大约半分钟，等到筋脉完全复位之后，王大壮双手握住林婉仪的脚踝，看似用力地扭动了几下，手法专业，动作流畅，还发出几声清脆的咔咔声响。

    林婉仪全程没有感觉到任何疼痛，只是听到那几声骨骼的响动，下意识地绷紧了身体。

    “好了。”王大壮松开手，把她的脚轻轻放下，抬起头对她笑了笑，“林姐，你试试看，还疼不疼？”

    林婉仪将信将疑地活动了一下脚踝，发现完全不疼了，又试着转了两圈，灵活自如，跟没受伤前一模一样。

    她惊讶地瞪大了眼睛，小心翼翼地把脚放进高跟鞋里，扶着三轮车站起身，试探着走了两步。

    每一步都稳稳当当，脚踝没有任何不适。

    “真的好了？”林婉仪不敢相信地又走了几步，甚至还轻轻跳了一下，脚踝完全正常，就像是刚才的扭伤只是一场幻觉。

    她转过身，看着王大壮，脸上的表情从惊讶变成了惊叹，又从惊叹变成了一种说不清道不明的意味。

    “大壮，你太厉害了。”

    当年她去村里的时候，这个年轻人傻里傻气的，见人就咧着嘴笑，她那时候觉得他有些可爱，但也仅此而已。
content_en:
Lin Wanyi bit her lip. The pain in her ankle became more and more intense, as if countless needles were pricking her.

    She has important guests to entertain this afternoon. As the director of operations, she must be present and must not be absent.

    "Can you really cure it?" She looked at Wang Dazhuang with a hint of doubt in her eyes, "Don't you only know how to grow fruits? How can you heal muscles and bones?"

    "I have learned a little bit, the craft passed down from my ancestors." Wang Dazhuang grinned and didn't explain much, "Sister Lin, please bear with it, you may feel a little sore, but it won't hurt."

    As he spoke, he held Lin Wanyi's left foot with both hands and placed his palm on her swollen ankle. The spiritual energy in his body slowly moved and entered her ankle.

    The moment the spiritual energy penetrated into the muscles and veins, Lin Wanyi felt a warm air flow spread from her ankles. The tingling sensation quickly subsided, replaced by a sore and swollen comfort, like being soaked in warm water.

    Wang Dazhuang's eyes were fixed on her ankle without blinking. His spiritual vision technique allowed him to clearly see that wherever the spiritual energy flowed, the twisted and misplaced tendons seemed to be gently smoothed by an invisible hand, returning to their original position bit by bit.

    The swollen soft tissue is quickly repaired under the nourishment of spiritual energy, the blood stasis dissipates, and the redness and swelling subside.

    This process lasted for about half a minute. After the tendons were completely restored, Wang Dazhuang held Lin Wanyi's ankle with both hands and twisted it seemingly forcefully a few times. His technique was professional, the movements were smooth, and he made several crisp click sounds.

    Lin Wanyi didn't feel any pain during the whole process. She just heard the sounds of the bones and subconsciously tensed her body.

    "Okay." Wang Dazhuang let go of her hand, gently put down her feet, raised his head and smiled at her, "Sister Lin, try it, does it still hurt?"

    Lin Wanyi moved her ankle doubtfully, and found that it no longer hurt at all. She tried turning it twice more, and it was as flexible as before she was injured.

    Her eyes widened in surprise, she carefully put her feet into the high heels, stood up on the tricycle station, and took two tentative steps.

    Every step was steady and there was no discomfort in my ankles.

    "Really healed?" Lin Wanyi took a few more steps in disbelief, and even jumped slightly. Her ankle was completely normal, as if the sprain just now was just an illusion.

    She turned around and looked at Wang Dazhuang. The expression on her face changed from surprise to exclamation, and then from exclamation to an inexplicable meaning.

    "Dazhuang, you are so awesome."

    When she went to the village, this young man was silly and grinned when he saw people. She thought he was a little cute at that time, but that was all.
title_en: Chapter 20 Da Zhuang, you are so awesome!
